title: goniophlebium owariense
intro: Goniophlebium owariense, commonly known as the Owari fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of epiphytic fern, which grows on other plants, typically trees, using aerial roots. The Owari fern has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the Owari fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
